# RFP ACT SACT 26-17

Request for Proposal for **Next Generation Modelling and Simulation (NexGen M&S) Programme**.

HQ SACT has recently completed reviews of proposals received in response to RFP-ACT-SACT-26-17 NexGen M&S Capability, SPRINT 2.

Presentations were reviewed and evaluated in accordance with the BI-SC 60-70 Procurement Directive by a Contract Awards Committee consisting of a Chairperson (the Financial Controller) the Contracting Officer, technical experts, Legal Counsel, an independent member, and a recorder.

The below bidding teams were selected and shall continue to participate in **Sprint 3** of this Agile Procurement.

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Sprint 2 Selectees** | **Company Address** |
| By Light Professional IT Services LLC | 8484 Westpark Drive, Suite 600, McLean, VA, 22102, USA |
| Deloitte MSC Limited | 1 New Street Square, London, United Kingdom, EC4A 3HQ |
| Lockheed Martin Rotary and Mission Systems Training and Logistics Solutions | 100 Global Innovation Circle, Orlando, FL 32825, USA |
| Trideum Corporation | 675 Discovery Drive, Suite 300, Huntsville, AL 35806, USA |

The below RFP Amendment is only applicable to those bidding teams down-selected (listed in the above table) and the HQ SACT Contracting Office will only be evaluating capabilities and/or proposals from those bidders:

[**Click here to open RFP ACT SACT 26-17 Amendment #7**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/rfp026017_amdt7.pdf)_(issued 28 Sep 2026)_

[**Pricing**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/rfp026017_pricing-sprint3.xlsx) \| [**Appendix 1 – Requirements**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/rfp026017_appendix1.xlsx) \| [**Appendix 2 – Compliance Mechanism**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/rfp026017_appendix2.xlsm)

[**Click here to open RFP ACT SACT 26-17 Sprint 2 Questions and Answers #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/rfp026017_sprint2_qa1.pdf)
